```rs
fn default_export_max() -> usize {
    256
}

pub fn pe_inspect(request: PeInspectRequest) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    diagnose_pe(&request.path)
}

pub fn pe_exports(request: PeExportsRequest) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.max <= 10_000,
        "pe_exports max must not exceed 10000"
    );
    let exports = read_export_symbols(&request.path)?;
    let filter = request
        .filter
        .as_ref()
        .map(|value| value.to_ascii_lowercase());
    let filtered = filter_exports(&exports, filter.as_deref());
    let values = filtered
        .iter()
        .take(request.max)
        .map(|export| export_symbol_value(export))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
    Ok(json!({
        "path": request.path,
        "total_exports": exports.len(),
        "filtered_exports": filtered.len(),
        "max": request.max,
        "returned": values.len(),
        "limit": request.max,
        "truncated": filtered.len() > request.max,
        "exports": values,
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_symbols_nearest(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: SymbolsNearestRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.address)?;
    let address_info = state.ttd.address_info(AddressInfoRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        address: request.address.clone(),
    })?;
    let address_info = serde_json::to_value(address_info)?;
    let Some(module) = address_info["module"].as_object() else {
        return Ok(json!({
            "session_id": request.session_id,
            "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
            "address": address,
            "address_info": address_info,
            "symbol": null,
            "reason": "address did not resolve to a loaded module"
        }));
    };
    let Some(path) = module.get("path").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
        return Ok(json!({
            "session_id": request.session_id,
            "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
            "address": address,
            "address_info": address_info,
            "symbol": null,
            "reason": "module path is not available"
        }));
    };
    let rva = module
        .get("rva")
        .and_then(Value::as_u64)
        .context("address_info module did not include an RVA")?;
    let path = PathBuf::from(path);
    let exports = read_export_symbols(&path)?;
    let nearest = nearest_export(&exports, rva as u32);
    let export_sample = request.include_exports.then(|| {
        exports
            .iter()
            .take(64)
            .map(export_symbol_value)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
    });
    let nearest_value = nearest.map(|export| {
        let displacement = rva.saturating_sub(export.rva as u64);
        json!({
            "export": export_symbol_value(export),
            "displacement": displacement,
            "displacement_hex": format!("{displacement:X}"),
            "display": export_display_name(export, displacement),
            "confidence": if export.forwarder.is_some() { "forwarder" } else { "export_nearest" }
        })
    });

    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "address": address,
        "address_info": address_info,
        "module_path": path,
        "rva": rva,
        "rva_hex": format!("{rva:X}"),
        "symbol": nearest_value,
        "exports": {
            "count": exports.len(),
            "sample": export_sample,
            "sample_limit": if request.include_exports { 64 } else { 0 },
            "sample_truncated": request.include_exports && exports.len() > 64
        },
        "notes": [
            "Nearest export is not the same as private PDB symbol lookup.",
            "Use this as a low-fidelity fallback when private symbols are unavailable."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn symbols_diagnose(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: SymbolsDiagnoseRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    if request.name.is_some() && request.address.is_some() {
        bail!("symbols diagnose accepts either name or address, not both");
    }
    let trace_info = status_value(state.ttd.trace_info(request.session_id));
    let capabilities = status_value(state.ttd.capabilities(request.session_id));
    let module_scope = symbol_module_scope(state, &request)?;
    let checks = symbol_diagnostic_checks(capabilities.get("value"), &module_scope);
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "trace_info": trace_info,
        "capabilities": capabilities,
        "module_scope": module_scope,
        "checks": checks,
        "next_steps": [
            "Confirm symbols.symbol_path includes the expected symbol server or private symbol path.",
            "Confirm symbols.image_path includes local binaries when stack walking or disassembly is low fidelity.",
            "Use modules/module info to select a narrower module before future PDB/source diagnostics.",
            "Use windbg-tool recipes symbol-health for the broader TimDbg workflow."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn symbols_doctor(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: SymbolsDoctorRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let subject = resolve_doctor_subject(&request)?;
    let address = request
        .address
        .as_deref()
        .map(parse_u64_argument)
        .transpose()?;
    Ok(json!({
        "schema_version": 1,
        "subject": doctor_subject_value(&subject),
        "doctor": symbol_source_doctor_value(state, &subject, address)?
    }))
}

enum DoctorSubject {
    Ttd {
        session: SessionId,
        cursor: Option<CursorId>,
    },
    Target {
        target: u64,
    },
}

fn resolve_doctor_subject(request: &SymbolsDoctorRequest) -> anyhow::Result<DoctorSubject> {
    if request.target_id.is_some() && (request.session_id.is_some() || request.cursor_id.is_some())
    {
        bail!("choose either target_id or session_id/cursor_id, not both");
    }
    if let Some(target) = request.target_id {
        return Ok(DoctorSubject::Target { target });
    }
    match (request.session_id, request.cursor_id) {
        (Some(session), cursor) => Ok(DoctorSubject::Ttd { session, cursor }),
        (None, Some(_)) => bail!("session_id is required with cursor_id"),
        (None, None) => bail!("symbols doctor requires target_id or session_id"),
    }
}

fn doctor_subject_value(subject: &DoctorSubject) -> Value {
    match subject {
        DoctorSubject::Ttd { session, cursor } => json!({
            "kind": if cursor.is_some() { "ttd_cursor" } else { "ttd_session" },
            "backend": "ttd_replay",
            "ids": {
                "session_id": session,
                "cursor_id": cursor
            },
            "stability": "replayable"
        }),
        DoctorSubject::Target { target } => json!({
            "kind": "target",
            "backend": "dbgeng_target",
            "ids": {
                "target_id": target
            },
            "stability": "target_state"
        }),
    }
}

fn symbol_source_doctor_value(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    subject: &DoctorSubject,
    address: Option<u64>,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    match subject {
        DoctorSubject::Ttd { session, cursor } => {
            let nearest = if let (Some(cursor), Some(address)) = (*cursor, address) {
                status_value(ttd_symbols_nearest(
                    state,
                    SymbolsNearestRequest {
                        session_id: *session,
                        cursor_id: cursor,
                        address: format!("0x{address:X}"),
                        include_exports: false,
                    },
                ))
            } else {
                json!({
                    "ok": false,
                    "error": "Pass cursor_id and address for nearest-symbol/source quality checks."
                })
            };
            Ok(json!({
                "status": "ok",
                "duration_ms": Value::Null,
                "truncated": false,
                "value": {
                    "trace_info": status_value(state.ttd.trace_info(*session)),
                    "nearest_symbol": nearest
                },
                "diagnostics": [
                    {
                        "id": "symbols.source.follow_up",
                        "severity": "info",
                        "summary": "Use focused symbol/source commands for deeper diagnosis.",
                        "detail": "This doctor composes currently available trace and nearest-symbol checks.",
                        "confidence": "high",
                        "fix": {
                            "description": "Run symbols diagnose or symbols nearest with the current address.",
                            "command": "windbg-tool symbols diagnose --session <id>"
                        }
                    }
                ],
                "command": "symbols doctor"
            }))
        }
        DoctorSubject::Target { target } => {
            let symbol = if let Some(address) = address {
                status_value(state.targets.symbol_by_offset(TargetAddressRequest {
                    target_id: *target,
                    address,
                }))
            } else {
                json!({ "ok": false, "error": "Pass address for target symbol/source checks." })
            };
            let source = if let Some(address) = address {
                status_value(state.targets.source_by_offset(TargetAddressRequest {
                    target_id: *target,
                    address,
                }))
            } else {
                json!({ "ok": false, "error": "Pass address for target symbol/source checks." })
            };
            let status = status_value(
                state
                    .targets
                    .target_status(TargetRequest { target_id: *target }),
            );
            Ok(json!({
                "status": "ok",
                "duration_ms": Value::Null,
                "truncated": false,
                "value": {
                    "target_status": status,
                    "symbol_by_offset": symbol,
                    "source_by_offset": source
                },
                "diagnostics": [
                    {
                        "id": "symbols.target.follow_up",
                        "severity": "info",
                        "summary": "Target symbol quality depends on DbgEng symbol path and loaded modules.",
                        "detail": "This doctor samples target status plus optional offset lookups.",
                        "confidence": "high",
                        "fix": {
                            "description": "Confirm symbol path and module load state on the target session.",
                            "command": null
                        }
                    }
                ],
                "command": "symbols doctor"
            }))
        }
    }
}

fn symbol_module_scope(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: &SymbolsDiagnoseRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    if request.name.is_none() && request.address.is_none() {
        let modules = status_value(state.ttd.list_modules(request.session_id));
        let pe_diagnostics = modules["value"]["modules"]
            .as_array()
            .map(|modules| session_pe_diagnostics(modules))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
                json!({
                    "ok": false,
                    "error": "module list is unavailable"
                })
            });
        return Ok(json!({
            "kind": "session",
            "modules": modules,
            "pe_diagnostics": pe_diagnostics
        }));
    }

    let address = request
        .address
        .as_deref()
        .map(parse_u64_argument)
        .transpose()?;
    let module = status_value(state.ttd.module_info(ModuleInfoRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        name: request.name.clone(),
        address,
    }));
    let pe_diagnostics = module["value"]["module"]
        .as_object()
        .map(|_| module_pe_diagnostics(&module["value"]["module"]))
        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
            json!({
                "ok": false,
                "error": "module info is unavailable"
            })
        });
    Ok(json!({
        "kind": if request.name.is_some() { "module_name" } else { "module_address" },
        "module": module,
        "pe_diagnostics": pe_diagnostics
    }))
}

fn session_pe_diagnostics(modules: &[Value]) -> Value {
    const MAX_PARSED_MODULES: usize = 32;

    let mut with_path_count = 0usize;
    let mut local_file_count = 0usize;
    let mut parsed_count = 0usize;
    let mut samples = Vec::new();

    for module in modules {
        let Some(path) = module_path(module) else {
            continue;
        };
        with_path_count += 1;
        let path = PathBuf::from(path);
        if !path.exists() {
            continue;
        }
        local_file_count += 1;
        if samples.len() >= MAX_PARSED_MODULES {
            continue;
        }
        let diagnostic = module_pe_diagnostics(module);
        if diagnostic["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true) {
            parsed_count += 1;
        }
        samples.push(diagnostic);
    }

    json!({
        "ok": true,
        "total_modules": modules.len(),
        "modules_with_path": with_path_count,
        "local_files": local_file_count,
        "parsed_count": parsed_count,
        "sample_limit": MAX_PARSED_MODULES,
        "truncated": local_file_count > MAX_PARSED_MODULES,
        "samples": samples,
        "hint": "Use symbols diagnose with name or address for a single-module PE/PDB identity."
    })
}

fn module_pe_diagnostics(module: &Value) -> Value {
    let name = module["name"].as_str().unwrap_or_default();
    let Some(path) = module_path(module) else {
        return json!({
            "ok": false,
            "module": name,
            "reason": "module path is not available"
        });
    };
    let path = PathBuf::from(path);
    if !path.exists() {
        return json!({
            "ok": false,
            "module": name,
            "path": path,
            "reason": "module binary is not available at this path"
        });
    }

    match diagnose_pe(&path) {
        Ok(pe) => json!({
            "ok": true,
            "module": name,
            "path": path,
            "pe": pe
        }),
        Err(error) => json!({
            "ok": false,
            "module": name,
            "path": path,
            "error": error.to_string()
        }),
    }
}

fn module_path(module: &Value) -> Option<&str> {
    module["path"].as_str().filter(|path| !path.is_empty())
}

fn filter_exports<'a>(exports: &'a [ExportSymbol], filter: Option<&str>) -> Vec<&'a ExportSymbol> {
    exports
        .iter()
        .filter(|export| {
            let Some(filter) = filter else {
                return true;
            };
            export
                .name
                .as_deref()
                .is_some_and(|name| name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(filter))
                || export
                    .forwarder
                    .as_deref()
                    .is_some_and(|name| name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(filter))
                || export.ordinal.to_string().contains(filter)
        })
        .collect()
}

fn nearest_export(exports: &[ExportSymbol], rva: u32) -> Option<&ExportSymbol> {
    exports
        .iter()
        .filter(|export| export.forwarder.is_none() && export.rva <= rva)
        .max_by_key(|export| export.rva)
}

fn export_display_name(export: &ExportSymbol, displacement: u64) -> String {
    let name = export
        .name
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("#{}", export.ordinal));
    if displacement == 0 {
        name
    } else {
        format!("{name}+0x{displacement:x}")
    }
}

fn symbol_diagnostic_checks(capabilities: Option<&Value>, module_scope: &Value) -> Value {
    let symbols = capabilities.and_then(|value| value.get("symbols"));
    let native = capabilities
        .and_then(|value| value.get("native"))
        .and_then(Value::as_bool);
    let symbol_path = symbols
        .and_then(|value| value.get("symbol_path"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let image_path = symbols
        .and_then(|value| value.get("image_path"))
        .and_then(Value::as_str)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let public_symbols = symbols
        .and_then(|value| value.get("microsoft_public_symbols"))
        .and_then(Value::as_bool)
        .unwrap_or(false);
    let binary_path_count = symbols
        .and_then(|value| value.get("binary_path_count"))
        .and_then(Value::as_u64)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let module_data_available = module_scope["modules"]["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true)
        || module_scope["module"]["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true);
    let pe_diagnostics = &module_scope["pe_diagnostics"];
    let pe_identity_available = pe_diagnostics["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true)
        && (pe_diagnostics["parsed_count"].as_u64().unwrap_or_default() > 0
            || pe_diagnostics["pe"].is_object());
    let pdb_identity_available = pe_diagnostics["pe"]["codeview"].is_object()
        || pe_diagnostics["samples"].as_array().is_some_and(|samples| {
            samples
                .iter()
                .any(|sample| sample["pe"]["codeview"].is_object())
        });

    json!([
        {
            "id": "native-replay",
            "status": if native == Some(true) { "pass" } else { "warn" },
            "evidence": native,
            "why_it_matters": "Native replay is required for real module inventories and cursor-backed symbol context."
        },
        {
            "id": "symbol-path",
            "status": if symbol_path.is_empty() { "warn" } else { "pass" },
            "evidence": symbol_path,
            "why_it_matters": "DbgHelp/SymSrv need a symbol path before public or private PDBs can be found."
        },
        {
            "id": "microsoft-public-symbols",
            "status": if public_symbols { "pass" } else { "info" },
            "evidence": public_symbols,
            "why_it_matters": "Public Microsoft symbols are enough for many Windows module/function names."
        },
        {
            "id": "binary-path",
            "status": if !image_path.is_empty() || binary_path_count > 0 { "pass" } else { "info" },
            "evidence": {
                "image_path": image_path,
                "binary_path_count": binary_path_count
            },
            "why_it_matters": "Local binaries improve stack walking, disassembly, and symbol-server binary fallback workflows."
        },
        {
            "id": "module-data",
            "status": if module_data_available { "pass" } else { "warn" },
            "evidence": module_scope,
            "why_it_matters": "Module identity is the anchor for timestamp/size/PDB/source diagnostics."
        },
        {
            "id": "pe-image-identity",
            "status": if pe_identity_available { "pass" } else { "info" },
            "evidence": pe_diagnostics,
            "why_it_matters": "PE timestamp and SizeOfImage form the symbol-server key for image/binary lookup."
        },
        {
            "id": "pdb-codeview-identity",
            "status": if pdb_identity_available { "pass" } else { "info" },
            "evidence": pe_diagnostics,
            "why_it_matters": "RSDS GUID plus age form the symbol-server key for PDB lookup."
        },
        {
            "id": "source-fidelity",
            "status": "future",
            "evidence": "PDB source-file and checksum inspection is not implemented yet.",
            "why_it_matters": "Source paths should be resolved with trailing-component matching and verified with hashes where available."
        }
    ])
}

fn status_value<T: serde::Serialize>(result: anyhow::Result<T>) -> Value {
    match result {
        Ok(value) => match serde_json::to_value(value) {
            Ok(value) => json!({ "ok": true, "value": value }),
            Err(error) => json!({ "ok": false, "error": error.to_string() }),
        },
        Err(error) => json!({ "ok": false, "error": error.to_string() }),
    }
}
```

```rs
#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct TargetDisassembleAnalysisRequest {
    pub target_id: TargetId,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub address: Option<String>,

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct TargetMemoryAnalysisRequest {
    pub target_id: TargetId,
    pub address: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_memory_size")]
    pub size: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct TargetMemoryDumpRequest {
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub base: TargetMemoryAnalysisRequest,
    #[serde(default = "default_dump_format")]
    pub format: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct TargetMemoryStringsRequest {
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub base: TargetMemoryAnalysisRequest,
    #[serde(default = "default_encoding")]
    pub encoding: String,
    #[serde(default = "default_min_len")]
    pub min_len: usize,
    #[serde(default = "default_max_strings")]
    pub max_strings: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct TargetMemoryDpsRequest {
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub base: TargetMemoryAnalysisRequest,
    #[serde(default = "default_pointer_size")]
    pub pointer_size: u32,

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]

    pub target_id: TargetId,
    pub address: String,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub offset: u64,
    #[serde(default = "default_chase_depth")]
    pub depth: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_pointer_size")]
    pub pointer_size: u32,

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]

    pub target_id: TargetId,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub address: Option<String>,
    #[serde(default = "default_stack_size")]
    pub size: u32,
    #[serde(default = "default_max_candidates")]
    pub max_candidates: usize,
    #[serde(default = "default_min_confidence")]
    pub min_confidence: f64,
}

fn read_target_bytes(
    state: &ServiceState,
    target_id: TargetId,
    address: u64,
    size: u32,
) -> anyhow::Result<(u64, Vec<u8>)> {
    ensure!(size > 0, "size must be greater than zero");
    ensure!(size <= 65536, "size must be 65536 bytes or less");
    let response = state.targets.read_memory(TargetMemoryReadRequest {
        target_id,
        address,
        size,
    })?;
    let bytes = hex_to_bytes(&response.memory.data)?;
    Ok((response.memory.address, bytes))
}

fn resolve_target_pc(state: &ServiceState, target_id: TargetId) -> anyhow::Result<u64> {
    let regs = state.targets.core_registers(TargetRequest { target_id })?;
    regs.registers
        .instruction_offset
        .context("target core registers did not include instruction_offset; pass address")
}

fn resolve_target_sp(state: &ServiceState, target_id: TargetId) -> anyhow::Result<u64> {
    let regs = state.targets.core_registers(TargetRequest { target_id })?;
    regs.registers
        .stack_offset
        .context("target core registers did not include stack_offset; pass address")
}

fn stack_read_from_bytes(address: u64, bytes: &[u8]) -> Value {
    let mut pointers = Vec::new();
    let mut offset = 0usize;
    while offset + 8 <= bytes.len() {
        let slot = address + offset as u64;
        let value = u64::from_le_bytes(bytes[offset..offset + 8].try_into().unwrap());
        pointers.push(json!({
            "address": slot,
            "offset": offset,
            "value": value,
            "module": Value::Null,
        }));
        offset += 8;
    }
    json!({
        "address": address,
        "size": bytes.len(),
        "pointers": pointers,
    })
}

pub fn target_disassemble(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetDisassembleAnalysisRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.count > 0 && request.count <= 256,
        "count must be 1..=256"
    );
    ensure!(
        request.bytes > 0 && request.bytes <= 4096,
        "bytes must be 1..=4096"
    );
    let address = match request.address.as_deref() {
        Some(value) => parse_u64_argument(value)?,
        None => resolve_target_pc(state, request.target_id)?,
    };
    let (address, bytes) = read_target_bytes(state, request.target_id, address, request.bytes)?;
    Ok(json!({
        "target_id": request.target_id,
        "architecture": "x64",
        "address": address,
        "address_hex": format!("0x{address:X}"),
        "bytes_read": bytes.len(),
        "instructions": disassemble_x64(address, &bytes, request.count as usize),
    }))
}

pub fn target_memory_dump(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetMemoryDumpRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.base.address)?;
    let (address, bytes) =
        read_target_bytes(state, request.base.target_id, address, request.base.size)?;
    let mut dump = memory_dump(address, &bytes, &request.format)?;
    if let Some(object) = dump.as_object_mut() {
        object.insert("target_id".into(), json!(request.base.target_id));
        object.insert("address".into(), json!(address));
        object.insert("address_hex".into(), json!(format!("0x{address:X}")));
        object.insert("size".into(), json!(bytes.len()));
    }
    Ok(dump)
}

pub fn target_memory_classify(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetMemoryAnalysisRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.address)?;
    let (address, bytes) = read_target_bytes(state, request.target_id, address, request.size)?;
    let mut value = classify_memory(address, &bytes);
    if let Some(object) = value.as_object_mut() {
        object.insert("target_id".into(), json!(request.target_id));
    }
    Ok(value)
}

pub fn target_memory_strings(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetMemoryStringsRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.base.address)?;
    let (address, bytes) =
        read_target_bytes(state, request.base.target_id, address, request.base.size)?;
    let encoding = request.encoding.to_ascii_lowercase();
    let mut strings = Vec::new();
    if encoding == "ascii" || encoding == "both" {
        strings.extend(ascii_strings(address, &bytes));
    }
    if matches!(encoding.as_str(), "utf16" | "utf-16" | "both") {
        strings.extend(utf16le_strings(address, &bytes));
    }
    strings.retain(|entry| {
        entry["length"]
            .as_u64()
            .map(|len| len as usize >= request.min_len)
            .unwrap_or(false)
    });
    strings.truncate(request.max_strings);
    Ok(json!({
        "target_id": request.base.target_id,
        "address": address,
        "address_hex": format!("0x{address:X}"),
        "size": bytes.len(),
        "encoding": request.encoding,
        "min_len": request.min_len,
        "count": strings.len(),
        "strings": strings,
    }))
}

pub fn target_memory_dps(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetMemoryDpsRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.pointer_size == 4 || request.pointer_size == 8,
        "pointer_size must be 4 or 8"
    );
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.base.address)?;
    let (address, bytes) =
        read_target_bytes(state, request.base.target_id, address, request.base.size)?;
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    let step = request.pointer_size as usize;
    let mut offset = 0usize;
    while offset + step <= bytes.len() {
        let slot = address + offset as u64;
        let value = read_pointer_value(&bytes[offset..], request.pointer_size)?;
        rows.push(json!({
            "address": slot,
            "address_hex": format!("0x{slot:X}"),
            "value": value,
            "value_hex": format!("0x{value:X}"),
            "plausible_pointer": plausible_x64_pointer(value),
        }));
        offset += step;
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "target_id": request.base.target_id,
        "address": address,
        "address_hex": format!("0x{address:X}"),
        "pointer_size": request.pointer_size,
        "count": rows.len(),
        "rows": rows,
    }))
}

pub fn target_memory_chase(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetMemoryChaseRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.depth > 0 && request.depth <= 32,
        "depth must be 1..=32"
    );
    ensure!(
        request.pointer_size == 4 || request.pointer_size == 8,
        "pointer_size must be 4 or 8"
    );
    let mut current = parse_u64_argument(&request.address)?;
    let mut chain = Vec::new();
    for index in 0..request.depth {
        let read_at = current.saturating_add(request.offset);
        match state.targets.read_memory(TargetMemoryReadRequest {
            target_id: request.target_id,
            address: read_at,
            size: request.pointer_size,
        }) {
            Ok(response) => {
                let bytes = hex_to_bytes(&response.memory.data)?;
                if bytes.len() < request.pointer_size as usize {
                    chain.push(json!({
                        "index": index,
                        "address": read_at,
                        "error": "short_read",
                    }));
                    break;
                }
                let value = read_pointer_value(&bytes, request.pointer_size)?;
                chain.push(json!({
                    "index": index,
                    "address": read_at,
                    "address_hex": format!("0x{read_at:X}"),
                    "value": value,
                    "value_hex": format!("0x{value:X}"),
                    "plausible_pointer": plausible_x64_pointer(value),
                }));
                if value == 0 || !plausible_x64_pointer(value) {
                    break;
                }
                current = value;
            }
            Err(error) => {
                chain.push(json!({
                    "index": index,
                    "address": read_at,
                    "error": error.to_string(),
                }));
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "target_id": request.target_id,
        "start": request.address,
        "offset": request.offset,
        "depth": request.depth,
        "pointer_size": request.pointer_size,
        "steps": chain.len(),
        "chain": chain,
    }))
}

pub fn target_stack_recover(
    state: &ServiceState,
    request: TargetStackRecoverRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        (0.0..=1.0).contains(&request.min_confidence),
        "min_confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0"
    );
    ensure!(request.max_candidates > 0, "max_candidates must be > 0");
    ensure!(
        request.max_candidates <= 512,
        "max_candidates must be <= 512"
    );
    let address = match request.address.as_deref() {
        Some(value) => parse_u64_argument(value)?,
        None => resolve_target_sp(state, request.target_id)?,
    };
    let (address, bytes) = read_target_bytes(state, request.target_id, address, request.size)?;
    let stack_value = stack_read_from_bytes(address, &bytes);
    let candidates =
        recover_stack_candidates(&stack_value, request.max_candidates, request.min_confidence);
    Ok(json!({
        "target_id": request.target_id,
        "address": address,
        "address_hex": format!("0x{address:X}"),
        "size": bytes.len(),
        "stack": stack_value,
        "candidates": candidates,
        "heuristics": [
            "Pointer-sized stack values that look like canonical x64 code pointers are return-address candidates.",
            "Without module maps this is lower fidelity than TTD stack recover with decode_pointers."
        ],
    }))
}
```

```rs
use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub fn collect_timeline_events(
    events: &mut Vec<Value>,
    kind: &str,
    source: &Value,
    array_key: &str,
) {
    let Some(items) = timeline_source_items(source, array_key) else {
        return;
    };
    for item in items {
        let position = item
            .get("position")
            .cloned()
            .or_else(|| {
                item.get("module")
                    .and_then(|module| module.get("load_position"))
                    .cloned()
            })
            .unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        events.push(json!({
            "kind": kind,
            "event_kind": item.get("kind").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            "position": position,
            "sequence": position.get("sequence").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            "payload": item,
        }));
    }
}

pub fn collect_keyframe_events(events: &mut Vec<Value>, source: &Value) {
    let Some(items) = timeline_source_items(source, "keyframes") else {
        return;
    };
    for position in items {
        events.push(json!({
            "kind": "keyframe",
            "event_kind": "keyframe",
            "position": position,
            "sequence": position.get("sequence").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            "payload": position,
        }));
    }
}

pub fn timeline_source_items<'a>(source: &'a Value, array_key: &str) -> Option<&'a Vec<Value>> {
    let value = source.get("value")?;
    value
        .get(array_key)
        .and_then(Value::as_array)
        .or_else(|| value.as_array())
}

pub fn timeline_source_summary(source: &Value, array_key: &str) -> Value {
    if source["ok"].as_bool() != Some(true) {
        return source.clone();
    }

    let item_count = timeline_source_items(source, array_key).map_or(0, Vec::len);
    json!({
        "ok": true,
        "item_count": item_count,
        "items_omitted": true
    })
}

pub fn timeline_sequence(event: &Value) -> u64 {
    event["sequence"].as_u64().unwrap_or(u64::MAX)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn timeline_source_summary_omits_unbounded_items() {
        let source = json!({
            "ok": true,
            "value": [{ "sequence": 1 }, { "sequence": 2 }]
        });
        let summary = timeline_source_summary(&source, "keyframes");

        assert_eq!(summary["ok"], true);
        assert_eq!(summary["item_count"], 2);
        assert_eq!(summary["items_omitted"], true);
        assert!(summary.get("value").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn timeline_collects_top_level_exception_arrays() {
        let source = json!({
            "ok": true,
            "value": [{
                "position": { "sequence": 479966, "steps": 0 },
                "code": 0xE06D7363u64
            }]
        });
        let mut events = Vec::new();

        collect_timeline_events(&mut events, "exception", &source, "exceptions");

        assert_eq!(events.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(events[0]["kind"], "exception");
        assert_eq!(events[0]["sequence"], 479966);
    }
}
```

```rs
use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub fn triage_value(kind: &str, snapshot: Value) -> Value {
    let mut hypotheses = Vec::new();
    let diagnostics = snapshot["diagnostics"].clone();
    match kind {
        "symbol_health" => hypotheses.push(json!({
            "id": "symbol_health.requires_review",
            "confidence": "medium",
            "summary": "Review symbol_source and nearest_symbol evidence before trusting names or source paths.",
            "supporting_sections": ["symbol_source", "nearest_symbol"]
        })),
        "loader" => hypotheses.push(json!({
            "id": "loader.module_review",
            "confidence": "medium",
            "summary": "Review module paths, duplicate module names, and recently loaded modules for loader anomalies.",
            "supporting_sections": ["modules", "timeline_summary"]
        })),
        "deadlock" | "hang" => hypotheses.push(json!({
            "id": "hang.stack_threads_review",
            "confidence": "low",
            "summary": "Thread and stack evidence can identify waits, but this command does not yet prove lock ownership.",
            "supporting_sections": ["threads", "stack"]
        })),
        "access_violation" | "crash" => hypotheses.push(json!({
            "id": "crash.exception_stack_review",
            "confidence": "medium",
            "summary": "Inspect exception/timeline, current disassembly, stack, and symbol quality before assigning root cause.",
            "supporting_sections": ["timeline_summary", "current_disassembly", "stack", "symbol_source"]
        })),
        "memory_corruption" => hypotheses.push(json!({
            "id": "memory_corruption.needs_watchpoint",
            "confidence": "low",
            "summary": "Snapshot evidence can identify suspicious pointers or stacks; use watchpoint planning before replaying or mutating.",
            "supporting_sections": ["stack", "modules", "disassembly"]
        })),
        _ => {}
    }
    json!({
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": kind,
        "evidence": {
            "snapshot": snapshot
        },
        "hypotheses": hypotheses,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics,
        "next_actions": [
            { "safety": "safe", "command": "windbg-tool debug snapshot", "reason": "Refresh bounded evidence." },
            { "safety": "safe", "command": "windbg-tool symbols doctor", "reason": "Validate symbol/source quality." },
            { "safety": "safe", "command": "windbg-tool breakpoint plan", "reason": "Plan breakpoints/watchpoints before mutating the target." }
        ],
        "limitations": [
            "Triage commands report evidence and hypotheses, not final root-cause verdicts.",
            "Backend support varies; inspect debug capabilities for unsupported operations."
        ]
    })
}
```

```rs
pub fn ttd_disassemble(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: DisassembleRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(request.count > 0, "count must be greater than zero");
    ensure!(
        request.count <= 256,
        "count must be 256 instructions or less"
    );
    ensure!(request.bytes > 0, "bytes must be greater than zero");
    ensure!(request.bytes <= 4096, "bytes must be 4096 or less");

    let (address, context) = resolve_disasm_address(state, &request)?;
    let read = state.ttd.read_memory(ReadMemoryRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        address,
        size: request.bytes,
        policy: request.policy,
    })?;
    let read_value = serde_json::to_value(&read)?;
    let data = read_value["data"]
        .as_str()
        .context("ttd_read_memory response did not include hex data")?;
    let bytes = hex_to_bytes(data)?;
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "architecture": "x64",
        "address": address,
        "address_hex": format!("0x{address:X}"),
        "context": context,
        "read": read_value,
        "instructions": disassemble_x64(address, &bytes, request.count as usize),
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_stack_recover(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: StackRecoverRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        (0.0..=1.0).contains(&request.min_confidence),
        "min_confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0"
    );
    ensure!(
        request.max_candidates > 0,
        "max_candidates must be greater than zero"
    );
    ensure!(
        request.max_candidates <= 512,
        "max_candidates must be 512 or less"
    );

    let stack_read = state.ttd.stack_read(StackReadRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        size: request.size.unwrap_or(4096),
        offset_from_sp: request.offset_from_sp.unwrap_or(0),
        decode_pointers: true,
    })?;
    let stack_value = serde_json::to_value(&stack_read)?;
    let mut candidates =
        recover_stack_candidates(&stack_value, request.max_candidates, request.min_confidence);
    if request.target_info {
        enrich_stack_candidates(
            state,
            request.session_id,
            request.cursor_id,
            &mut candidates,
        );
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "stack": stack_value,
        "candidates": candidates,
        "heuristics": [
            "Pointer-sized stack values that land inside a loaded module are likely return-address candidates.",
            "Confidence is higher for module hits, aligned stack slots, and values that look like canonical x64 pointers.",
            "This is recovery evidence, not a trusted unwind; validate candidates with symbols, disassembly, and call-site context."
        ],
        "follow_up": [
            "Use ttd_disassemble with address=<candidate> to inspect code near a candidate.",
            "Use ttd_memory_watchpoint on a corrupted return-address slot to find writes in TTD."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_stack_backtrace(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: StackBacktraceRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.max_frames > 0,
        "max_frames must be greater than zero"
    );
    ensure!(
        request.max_frames <= 1024,
        "max_frames must not exceed 1024"
    );
    ensure!(
        (0.0..=1.0).contains(&request.min_confidence),
        "min_confidence must be between 0.0 and 1.0"
    );

    let registers = state.ttd.registers(request.session_id, request.cursor_id)?;
    let registers_value = serde_json::to_value(&registers)?;
    let stack_read = state.ttd.stack_read(StackReadRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        size: request.size,
        offset_from_sp: request.offset_from_sp.unwrap_or(0),
        decode_pointers: true,
    })?;
    let stack_value = serde_json::to_value(&stack_read)?;
    let candidate_budget = request.max_frames.saturating_sub(1);
    let mut candidates =
        recover_stack_candidates(&stack_value, candidate_budget, request.min_confidence);
    if request.target_info {
        enrich_stack_candidates(
            state,
            request.session_id,
            request.cursor_id,
            &mut candidates,
        );
    }

    let mut frames = Vec::new();
    if let Some(pc) = registers_value["program_counter"].as_u64() {
        let mut current = json!({
            "index": 0,
            "kind": "current_instruction",
            "address": pc,
            "address_hex": format!("0x{pc:016x}"),
            "confidence": 1.0,
            "reasons": ["current_program_counter"],
        });
        if request.target_info {
            current["target_info"] =
                address_info_status(state, request.session_id, request.cursor_id, pc);
        }
        frames.push(current);
    }
    for (index, candidate) in candidates.into_iter().enumerate() {
        frames.push(json!({
            "index": frames.len(),
            "kind": "recovered_return_address",
            "address": candidate["target"],
            "address_hex": candidate["target_hex"],
            "stack_slot": candidate["slot_address"],
            "stack_slot_hex": candidate["slot_address_hex"],
            "module": candidate["module"],
            "confidence": candidate["confidence"],
            "reasons": candidate["reasons"],
            "target_info": candidate.get("target_info").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null),
            "candidate_rank": index,
        }));
    }

    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "position": registers_value["position"],
        "thread": registers_value["thread"],
        "method": "heuristic_stack_scan",
        "trusted_unwind": false,
        "frames": frames,
        "stack_read": stack_value,
        "warnings": [
            "This is not a DbgHelp/DbgEng unwind and may include false positives.",
            "Use ttd_stack_recover, ttd_disassemble, symbols, and TTD watchpoints to validate suspicious return-address candidates."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_memory_dump(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: MemoryDumpRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let (address, read_value, bytes) = read_memory_bytes(state, &request.base)?;
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.base.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.base.cursor_id,
        "read": read_value,
        "dump": memory_dump(address, &bytes, &request.format)?,
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_memory_classify(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: MemoryAnalysisRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let (address, read_value, bytes) = read_memory_bytes(state, &request)?;
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "read": read_value,
        "classification": classify_memory(address, &bytes),
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_memory_strings(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: MemoryStringsRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.max_strings <= 10_000,
        "max_strings must not exceed 10000"
    );
    ensure!(
        matches!(request.encoding.as_str(), "ascii" | "utf16" | "both"),
        "encoding must be ascii, utf16, or both"
    );
    let (address, read_value, bytes) = read_memory_bytes(state, &request.base)?;
    let mut strings = Vec::new();
    if request.encoding == "ascii" || request.encoding == "both" {
        strings.extend(
            ascii_strings(address, &bytes)
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|item| {
                    item["text"]
                        .as_str()
                        .is_some_and(|text| text.len() >= request.min_len)
                })
                .map(|mut item| {
                    item["encoding"] = Value::String("ascii".to_string());
                    item
                }),
        );
    }
    if request.encoding == "utf16" || request.encoding == "both" {
        strings.extend(
            utf16le_strings(address, &bytes)
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|item| {
                    item["text"]
                        .as_str()
                        .is_some_and(|text| text.len() >= request.min_len)
                })
                .map(|mut item| {
                    item["encoding"] = Value::String("utf16".to_string());
                    item
                }),
        );
    }
    strings.sort_by_key(|item| item["address"].as_u64().unwrap_or(u64::MAX));
    let total_strings = strings.len();
    if strings.len() > request.max_strings {
        strings.truncate(request.max_strings);
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.base.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.base.cursor_id,
        "read": read_value,
        "encoding": request.encoding,
        "min_len": request.min_len,
        "total_strings": total_strings,
        "max_strings": request.max_strings,
        "returned": strings.len(),
        "limit": request.max_strings,
        "truncated": total_strings > request.max_strings,
        "strings": strings,
        "unavailable_bytes": if read_value["complete"].as_bool() == Some(false) {
            read_value["requested_size"]
                .as_u64()
                .unwrap_or_default()
                .saturating_sub(read_value["bytes_read"].as_u64().unwrap_or_default())
        } else {
            0
        }
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_memory_dps(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: MemoryDpsRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        matches!(request.pointer_size, 4 | 8),
        "pointer_size must be 4 or 8"
    );
    let (base, read_value, bytes) = read_memory_bytes(state, &request.base)?;
    let mut rows = Vec::new();
    for (index, chunk) in bytes.chunks(request.pointer_size as usize).enumerate() {
        if chunk.len() < request.pointer_size as usize {
            break;
        }
        let slot = base + (index as u64 * request.pointer_size as u64);
        let target = read_pointer_value(chunk, request.pointer_size)?;
        let mut row = json!({
            "slot": slot,
            "slot_hex": format!("0x{slot:016x}"),
            "value": target,
            "value_hex": format!("0x{target:016x}"),
            "plausible_x64_pointer": plausible_x64_pointer(target),
            "null": target == 0
        });
        if request.target_info && target != 0 {
            row["target_info"] = address_info_status(
                state,
                request.base.session_id,
                request.base.cursor_id,
                target,
            );
        }
        rows.push(row);
    }
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.base.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.base.cursor_id,
        "read": read_value,
        "pointer_size": request.pointer_size,
        "row_count": rows.len(),
        "rows": rows
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_memory_chase(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: MemoryChaseRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(request.depth > 0, "depth must be greater than zero");
    ensure!(request.depth <= 256, "depth must not exceed 256");
    ensure!(
        matches!(request.pointer_size, 4 | 8),
        "pointer_size must be 4 or 8"
    );

    let root_address = parse_u64_argument(&request.address)?;
    let mut current = root_address;
    let mut hops = Vec::new();
    let mut stop_reason = "max_depth";

    for depth in 0..request.depth {
        let read_address = current
            .checked_add(request.offset)
            .context("pointer read address overflowed")?;
        let read = state.ttd.read_memory(ReadMemoryRequest {
            session_id: request.session_id,
            cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
            address: read_address,
            size: request.pointer_size,
            policy: request.policy,
        })?;
        let read_value = serde_json::to_value(&read)?;
        let data = read_value["data"]
            .as_str()
            .context("ttd_read_memory response did not include hex data")?;
        let bytes = hex_to_bytes(data)?;
        let target = read_pointer_value(&bytes, request.pointer_size)?;
        let mut hop = json!({
            "index": depth,
            "base_address": current,
            "read_address": read_address,
            "offset": request.offset,
            "pointer_size": request.pointer_size,
            "bytes": data,
            "target": target,
            "target_hex": format!("0x{target:016x}"),
            "null": target == 0,
            "read": read_value,
        });
        if request.target_info && target != 0 {
            hop["target_info"] =
                address_info_status(state, request.session_id, request.cursor_id, target);
        }
        hops.push(hop);
        if target == 0 {
            stop_reason = "null_pointer";
            break;
        }
        current = target;
    }

    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "root_address": root_address,
        "offset": request.offset,
        "pointer_size": request.pointer_size,
        "requested_depth": request.depth,
        "stop_reason": stop_reason,
        "hops": hops,
        "notes": [
            "Reads one pointer at base_address + offset per hop.",
            "Pointer chains are evidence, not proof of ownership or object type."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_timeline_events(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: TimelineEventsRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    ensure!(
        request.max_events <= 100_000,
        "max_events must not exceed 100000"
    );
    ensure!(
        matches!(
            request.kind.as_str(),
            "all" | "modules" | "threads" | "exceptions" | "keyframes"
        ),
        "kind must be all, modules, threads, exceptions, or keyframes"
    );

    let include = |wanted: &str| request.kind == "all" || request.kind == wanted;
    let mut events = Vec::new();
    let mut sources = Map::new();

    if include("modules") {
        let direct = serde_json::to_value(state.ttd.list_module_events(request.session_id)?)?;
        let wrapped = json!({ "ok": true, "value": direct });
        collect_timeline_events(&mut events, "module", &wrapped, "events");
        sources.insert(
            "modules".into(),
            timeline_source_summary(&wrapped, "events"),
        );
    }
    if include("threads") {
        let direct = serde_json::to_value(state.ttd.list_thread_events(request.session_id)?)?;
        let wrapped = json!({ "ok": true, "value": direct });
        collect_timeline_events(&mut events, "thread", &wrapped, "events");
        sources.insert(
            "threads".into(),
            timeline_source_summary(&wrapped, "events"),
        );
    }
    if include("exceptions") {
        let direct = serde_json::to_value(state.ttd.list_exceptions(request.session_id)?)?;
        let wrapped = json!({ "ok": true, "value": direct });
        collect_timeline_events(&mut events, "exception", &wrapped, "exceptions");
        sources.insert(
            "exceptions".into(),
            timeline_source_summary(&wrapped, "exceptions"),
        );
    }
    if include("keyframes") {
        let direct = serde_json::to_value(state.ttd.list_keyframes(request.session_id)?)?;
        let wrapped = json!({ "ok": true, "value": direct });
        collect_keyframe_events(&mut events, &wrapped);
        sources.insert(
            "keyframes".into(),
            timeline_source_summary(&wrapped, "keyframes"),
        );
    }

    events.sort_by(|left, right| {
        timeline_sequence(left)
            .cmp(&timeline_sequence(right))
            .then_with(|| left["kind"].as_str().cmp(&right["kind"].as_str()))
            .then_with(|| left.to_string().cmp(&right.to_string()))
    });

    let total_events = events.len();
    let mut event_counts = Map::new();
    for event in &events {
        if let Some(kind) = event["kind"].as_str() {
            let count = event_counts
                .entry(kind.to_string())
                .or_insert_with(|| Value::from(0_u64));
            *count = Value::from(count.as_u64().unwrap_or(0) + 1);
        }
    }
    if events.len() > request.max_events {
        events.truncate(request.max_events);
    }

    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "kind": request.kind,
        "total_events": total_events,
        "event_counts": event_counts,
        "max_events": request.max_events,
        "returned": events.len(),
        "limit": request.max_events,
        "truncated": total_events > request.max_events,
        "events": events,
        "sources": Value::Object(sources),
        "unsupported_recording_metadata": [
            "record clients",
            "custom events",
            "activities",
            "islands",
            "bounded user-data payload extraction"
        ],
        "notes": [
            "This timeline merges currently exposed trace metadata.",
            "Sources include only status and item counts; use the corresponding metadata command for full source data."
        ]
    }))
}

pub fn ttd_exception_focus(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: ExceptionFocusRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let exceptions = state.ttd.list_exceptions(request.session_id)?;
    let exception_items = serde_json::to_value(&exceptions)?;
    let exception_items = exception_items
        .as_array()
        .context("list_exceptions did not serialize to an array")?;
    let exception = exception_items
        .get(request.index)
        .cloned()
        .with_context(|| {
            format!(
                "exception index {} is outside the {} recorded exception events",
                request.index,
                exception_items.len()
            )
        })?;
    let requested_position = exception["position"].clone();
    let position: Position = serde_json::from_value(requested_position.clone())
        .context("exception position was not a valid TTD position")?;
    let requested_position_hex = format!("{:X}:{:X}", position.sequence, position.steps);
    let thread_unique_id = exception["thread_unique_id"].as_u64();
    let after = state.ttd.set_position(PositionRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        position: PositionOrPercent::Position(position),
        thread_unique_id,
    })?;
    let exception_code_hex = exception["code"]
        .as_u64()
        .map(|code| format!("0x{code:08X}"));

    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "exception_index": request.index,
        "exception": exception,
        "exception_code_hex": exception_code_hex,
        "requested_position": requested_position,
        "requested_position_hex": requested_position_hex,
        "thread_unique_id": thread_unique_id,
        "position": after,
        "notes": [
            "This command uses the exception's JSON position directly, avoiding decimal/hexadecimal transcription errors.",
            "When the trace records an owning thread, the cursor seeks on that TTD thread."
        ],
        "next_recommended_safe_commands": [
            "ttd_registers",
            "ttd_stack_backtrace",
            "ttd_disassemble"
        ]
    }))
}

fn resolve_disasm_address(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: &DisassembleRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<(u64, Value)> {
    if let Some(address) = request.address.as_deref() {
        return Ok((
            parse_u64_argument(address)?,
            json!({ "source": "explicit" }),
        ));
    }
    let context = state.ttd.register_context(RegisterContextRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        thread_id: request.thread_id,
    })?;
    let context_value = serde_json::to_value(&context)?;
    let rip = context_value["registers"]["rip"]
        .as_u64()
        .or_else(|| context_value["rip"].as_u64())
        .context("ttd_register_context response did not include registers.rip")?;
    Ok((
        rip,
        json!({ "source": "cursor_rip", "register_context": context_value }),
    ))
}

fn read_memory_bytes(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    request: &MemoryAnalysisRequest,
) -> anyhow::Result<(u64, Value, Vec<u8>)> {
    ensure!(request.size > 0, "size must be greater than zero");
    ensure!(request.size <= 1024 * 1024, "size must not exceed 1 MiB");
    let address = parse_u64_argument(&request.address)?;
    let read = state.ttd.read_memory(ReadMemoryRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        address,
        size: request.size,
        policy: request.policy,
    })?;
    let read_value = serde_json::to_value(&read)?;
    let data = read_value["data"]
        .as_str()
        .context("ttd_read_memory response did not include hex data")?;
    let bytes = hex_to_bytes(data)?;
    let address = read_value["address"].as_u64().unwrap_or(address);
    Ok((address, read_value, bytes))
}

fn enrich_stack_candidates(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    session_id: SessionId,
    cursor_id: CursorId,
    candidates: &mut [Value],
) {
    for candidate in candidates {
        let Some(target) = candidate["target"].as_u64() else {
            continue;
        };
        candidate["target_info"] = address_info_status(state, session_id, cursor_id, target);
    }
}

fn address_info_status(
    state: &mut ServiceState,
    session_id: SessionId,
    cursor_id: CursorId,
    address: u64,
) -> Value {
    match state.ttd.address_info(AddressInfoRequest {
        session_id,
        cursor_id,
        address: address.to_string(),
    }) {
        Ok(value) => json!({ "ok": true, "value": value }),
        Err(error) => json!({ "ok": false, "error": error.to_string() }),
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
pub struct ReplayToRequest {
    pub session_id: SessionId,
    pub cursor_id: CursorId,
    pub position: PositionOrPercent,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub thread_unique_id: Option<u64>,
}

/// Seek a cursor and return before/after positions (CLI `replay to`).
pub fn ttd_replay_to(state: &mut ServiceState, request: ReplayToRequest) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
    let before = state
        .ttd
        .cursor_position(request.session_id, request.cursor_id)?;
    let after = state.ttd.set_position(PositionRequest {
        session_id: request.session_id,
        cursor_id: request.cursor_id,
        position: request.position,
        thread_unique_id: request.thread_unique_id,
    })?;
    Ok(json!({
        "session_id": request.session_id,
        "cursor_id": request.cursor_id,
        "thread_unique_id": request.thread_unique_id,
        "before": before,
        "after": after,
    }))
}
```

`crates/windbg-ttd/src/analysis/util.rs`:

```rs
use anyhow::{bail, ensure, Context};

pub fn hex_to_bytes(data: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<u8>> {
    ensure!(data.len().is_multiple_of(2), "hex data length must be even");
    (0..data.len())
        .step_by(2)
        .map(|index| {
            u8::from_str_radix(&data[index..index + 2], 16)
                .with_context(|| format!("parsing hex byte at offset {index}"))
        })
        .collect()
}

pub fn parse_u64_argument(value: &str) -> anyhow::Result<u64> {
    let value = value.trim();
    if let Some(hex) = value
        .strip_prefix("0x")
        .or_else(|| value.strip_prefix("0X"))
    {
        return u64::from_str_radix(hex, 16).context("parsing hexadecimal integer");
    }
    value.parse::<u64>().context("parsing decimal integer")
}

pub fn ensure_json_object(value: serde_json::Value) -> anyhow::Result<serde_json::Value> {
    if value.is_object() {
        Ok(value)
    } else {
        bail!("tool arguments must be a JSON object")
    }
}
```

```rs
/// reported by the owning session. This contract describes the supported
/// operation shape and mutation policy independently of one session.

        "ttd_cursor" => json!({
            "backend": "ttd_cursor",
            "target_kind": "offline_replay",

                "x64": "implemented",
                "x86": "not_yet_exposed",

            "operations": {
                "read_memory": "supported",
                "disassemble": "supported_x64",

                "query_source": "supported_via_local_path_resolution",

                "continue": "unsupported",
                "set_breakpoint": "unsupported",
                "set_data_breakpoint": "supported_as_replay_memory_watchpoint",
                "write_dump": "unsupported",
                "time_travel": "supported",
                "jobs": "supported",
                "timeline": "supported"

            "required_identifiers": ["session_id", "cursor_id"],

        "dbgeng_live" | "dbgeng_target" => json!({

            "architectures": {
                "target_architecture": "reported_by_dbgeng",
                "host_architecture": "must_match_the_loaded_dbgeng_runtime"
            },
            "operations": {
                "read_memory": "supported",
                "disassemble": "supported",
                "stack": "supported",
                "query_symbols": "supported",
                "query_source": "supported",
                "query_virtual_memory_map": "supported_live_user_mode_only",
                "step": "supported_step_into_and_over",
                "continue": "supported",
                "continue_and_wait": "supported_with_opt_in_bounded_debuggee_output",
                "set_breakpoint": "supported_code_data_and_deferred_symbol",
                "set_data_breakpoint": "supported",
                "set_breakpoint_enabled": "supported",
                "write_dump": "supported",
                "time_travel": "unsupported",
                "jobs": "unsupported",
                "timeline": "unsupported"
```

```rs
use crate::service::ReplayService;
use crate::tools::ToolCall;
use anyhow::{bail, Context};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher;
use std::env;
use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
use std::time::Duration;

pub const PIPE_ENV: &str = "WINDBG_TOOL_PIPE";
const LEGACY_PIPE_ENV: &str = "TTD_MCP_PIPE";

pub fn default_pipe_name() -> String {
    if let Some(pipe) = env::var_os(PIPE_ENV).and_then(non_empty_os_string) {
        return pipe;
    }
    if let Some(pipe) = env::var_os(LEGACY_PIPE_ENV).and_then(non_empty_os_string) {
        return pipe;
    }

    let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();
    env::var("USERNAME")
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| "user".to_string())
        .hash(&mut hasher);
    if let Ok(current_dir) = env::current_dir() {
        current_dir.hash(&mut hasher);
    }
    format!(r"\\.\pipe\windbg-tool-{:016x}", hasher.finish())
}

fn non_empty_os_string(value: std::ffi::OsString) -> Option<String> {
    let value = value.to_string_lossy().trim().to_string();
    (!value.is_empty()).then_some(value)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
pub async fn run_daemon(pipe_name: String) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    windows::run_daemon(pipe_name).await
}

#[cfg(not(windows))]
pub async fn run_daemon(_pipe_name: String) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    bail!("the TTD daemon named-pipe transport is only supported on Windows")
}

#[cfg(windows)]
#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct DaemonClient {
    pipe_name: String,
}

#[cfg(windows)]
impl DaemonClient {
    pub fn new(pipe_name: String) -> Self {
        Self { pipe_name }
    }

    pub async fn health(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        self.request_json("GET", "/health", None).await
    }

    pub async fn tools(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        self.request_json("GET", "/tools", None).await
    }

    pub async fn sessions(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        self.request_json("GET", "/sessions", None).await
    }

    pub async fn targets(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        self.request_json("GET", "/targets", None).await
    }

    pub async fn shutdown(&self) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        self.request_json("POST", "/shutdown", Some(Value::Null))
            .await
    }

    pub async fn call_tool(&self, call: ToolCall) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        let response = self
            .request_json("POST", "/tools/call", Some(serde_json::to_value(call)?))
            .await?;
        if response["ok"].as_bool() == Some(true) {
            Ok(response["result"].clone())
        } else {
            let message = response["error"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap_or("daemon returned an unknown tool error");
            bail!("{message}")
        }
    }

    async fn request_json(
        &self,
        method: &str,
        path: &str,
        body: Option<Value>,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<Value> {
        windows::request_json(&self.pipe_name, method, path, body).await
    }
}
```
